versions.changelog:
Firecrawl Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Adds AI-native web scraping, crawling, domain mapping, and structured extraction capabilities via Firecrawl.
- Supports scraping single pages, crawling entire domains, mapping URLs, and extracting structured JSON according to user-defined schemas.
- Includes best-practice guidance for efficient, scalable, and resilient data extraction.
- Provides resource guides for API integration, SDK templates, and self-hosted deployments.
- Details anti-patterns and optimization strategies for cost-effective LLM-ready data processing.
